name: Facebook Marketplace deal-alert feed for flippers
one_liner: Scrape Marketplace for underpriced listings on a schedule and sell niche deal alerts (or the leads) to resellers, flippers and investors.
customer: High-volume resellers (appliances, treadmills, sheds), real-estate flippers, local businesses wanting leads
offer: Daily/hourly alerts or a spreadsheet of new listings filtered by item, price and location; or one 'radar' micro-tool per category
how_it_makes_money: Subscriptions: presenter suggests serious flippers would pay $30–150/month; cites an existing $29.99/month tool and $5/month category 'radar' tools; or sell high-value leads
startup_cost: low – scraping API plus a no-code front end
evidence: Existing Marketplace deal tool priced at $29.99/month – CVlZdvDthOM
Category 'radar' tools (e.g. appliances) at ~$5/month – CVlZdvDthOM

risks: Scraping Facebook may breach its terms

name: Free-pickup shed flipping
one_liner: Offer to collect unwanted sheds for free, then resell them delivered at a premium.
customer: Homeowners wanting a shed removed; buyers wanting a delivered shed
offer: Free removal for sellers; delivered used sheds for buyers
how_it_makes_money: Resale margin (example: free pickup vs ~$2,000 delivered)
evidence: Friend reportedly makes $600,000/year net flipping mostly used sheds – CVlZdvDthOM

name: Snail-mail story subscription
one_liner: Sell a serialised story told through physical letters (two a month) as a subscription and gift, grown with Meta ads and email.
customer: Women buying for themselves or as a gift for mothers (Mother's Day is the peak)
offer: Two letters a month telling a story over a year, with stationery, postcards and stickers; prepaid annual option
how_it_makes_money: $12/month or ~$100 prepaid per story; LTV about $180; email drives 38–50% of revenue
startup_cost: low – early per-shipment cost about $2–3 (stamp, envelope, paper, extras)
time_to_first_revenue: weeks (33 sign-ups at launch; first letters sent within a month)
